Boss Boss compact pedals browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive distortion browse by enclosure pedal Boss XT-2 Xtortion Published on July 12, 2005 Boss compact pedals distortion pedal schematics Information The Boss XT-2 Xtortion is a high-gain distortion pedal engineered for modern guitarists seeking precise tonal control and aggressive saturation. Designed for rock, metal, grunge, and other high-intensity styles, the XT-2 delivers a tight, punchy distortion with clear articulation and minimal noise. Its EQ section includes dedicated contour and punch controls, enabling players to sculpt a range of tones from scooped and aggressive to mid-forward and cutting. The pedal responds well to both single-coil and humbucking pickups and is optimized for riff-heavy playing, with strong note definition even under heavy gain. Housed in Boss's durable compact enclosure, the XT-2 offers reliable performance for both studio and stage applications. Controls Level: Adjusts the overall output volume Distortion: Sets the amount of gain and saturation Contour: Adjusts the midrange character from scooped to boosted Punch: Adds low-end and upper-mid emphasis for increased presence Specifications Power: 9V PP3 battery or compatible Boss PSA adapter Bypass: Buffered Enclosure: Compact Boss chassis with thumbscrew battery access Indicators: Red LED (effect status) Connectivity: Standard ¼" input and output jacks Power Access: External DC jack (9V), internal battery compartment Highlights High-gain distortion tailored for modern heavy styles Unique EQ section with Contour and Punch for detailed tone shaping Low-noise circuitry, even at high gain levels Maintains clarity and articulation with dense distortion Durable build and tool-free battery access for stage reliability Suitable for soloing, riffing, and rhythm work across varied genres Video Date ▼▲ Maker ▼▲ Video ▼▲ Time ▼▲ 2026-08-23 Leon Todd BOSS XT-2 Xtortion || Great or Garbage? 13:43 2026-07-09 Leon Todd IS the BOSS Xtortion Any Good? #guitar #pinkfloyd #bosspedals #guitartone 1:24 2025-02-16 DomeNightBearer I could not believe how this rare Boss Pedal actually sounds!
